classification.difficultyReason: Parts a and b are guided routine integrations that scaffold the rest. Part c requires the student to interpret even and odd symmetry as area and signed-area cancellation. Part d requires splitting the integrand into odd and even terms and using symmetry to halve the work. That is a representation change beyond plain integration, which is why it sits above p33-q12. The scaffolding and the lack of any parameter-solving or quadratic step keep it below p33-q11.
